A '''settlement''' existed on [[Nadiem/Legends|Nadiem]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was the principal settlement with respect to a number of others, including a village. A [[Battle of Nadiem|battle]] of the Clone Wars was fought at the main settlement.<ref name="Hide">{{StoryCite|story=Hide in Plain Sight|book=Free Comic Book Day|bformatted=Free Comic Book Day 2004 Special}}</ref>
